content:
Ted Lasso Season 4 officially returns (watch it here), with two other popular Apple TV+ shows also making their comebacks. Here's what's new and upcoming.

Apple TV+'s Slow Horses and Dark Matter are set to return, alongside Ted Lasso.

It looks like now is a great time to subscribe to Apple TV+.

Ted Lasso season 4 has officially returned, with two other popular shows hot on its heels.

Ted Lasso season 4 premieres today, with new episodes airing every Wednesday through October 7. In addition to bringing back many beloved characters, the new season adds fresh faces to the Lady Greyhounds.

Over the next few weeks, beyond Lasso, Apple TV+ has two other popular shows premiering new seasons:

Slow Horses season 6 premieres Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes dropping weekly through October 21.

Gary Oldman and the entire Slough House team are back. Here's the synopsis: "Season six finds the Slow Horses drawn into a deadly, high-stakes revenge game by Diana Taverner, taking them on the run for their lives."

Coming up even sooner is the return of the hit sci-fi series Dark Matter for a new season.

Dark Matter season 2 premieres Friday, August 28, with new episodes airing weekly through October 30.

Here's the show's synopsis:

Other notable upcoming Apple TV+ premieres include the Ryan Reynolds film Mayday, the Matthew McConaughey comedy series Brothers, and the crime thriller Last Seen.

Which Apple TV+ premiere are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or you can bundle it at a discount through Apple One.
